plan.description: Data Loading and Initial Quality Control (QC): In this step, we will load the single-cell RNA-seq dataset using Scanpy. We will initialize an AnnData object from the provided .h5ad file and perform quality control to filter out low-quality cells based on metrics like mitochondrial gene content, total UMIs, and number of detected genes.
input_filename: ./data/cell_annotation/dataset_debug_restricted.h5ad: A single-cell RNA-seq dataset containing gene expression profiles with cell barcodes and gene names
output_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct2/filtered_dataset.h5ad: Filtered and QC-passed single-cell RNA-seq dataset

plan.description: Normalization and Highly Variable Gene (HVG) Selection: Using Scanpy, standardize the QC-filtered data with total count normalization and log transformation. Then identify highly variable genes, which are important for downstream dimensionality reduction and clustering.
input_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct2/filtered_dataset.h5ad: Filtered and QC-passed single-cell RNA-seq dataset
output_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct2/normalized_dataset.h5ad: Normalized single-cell RNA-seq dataset with highly variable genes marked

plan.description: Dimensionality Reduction and Clustering: Perform principal component analysis (PCA) followed by non-linear dimensionality reduction (e.g., UMAP or t-SNE) using Scanpy. Subsequently, apply a clustering algorithm (like Leiden) to assign cluster labels to cells. This prepares the dataset for differential expression analysis, aiding in distinguishing cell populations.
input_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct2/normalized_dataset.h5ad: Normalized single-cell RNA-seq dataset with highly variable genes marked
output_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct2/dim_reduced_dataset.h5ad: Dimension-reduced single-cell dataset with clustering labels

plan.description: Differential Expression Analysis for Marker Gene Identification: Using the clustering results, perform differential expression analysis to identify marker genes that differentiate clusters. These markers are pivotal for determining which clusters are likely malignant. Methods within Scanpy (or integrated single-cell marker gene identification workflows) can be used in this step.
input_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct2/dim_reduced_dataset.h5ad: Dimension-reduced single-cell dataset with clustering labels
output_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct2/marker_genes.txt: List of differentially expressed marker genes for each cluster

plan.description: Malignant Cell Classification: Based on the differential expression results and known malignant marker genes, classify cells as malignant. Annotate the AnnData object with a new column indicating whether each cell is malignant or non-malignant. This classification facilitates further biological interpretation and downstream analysis.
input_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct2/dim_reduced_dataset.h5ad: Dimension-reduced single-cell dataset with clustering labels
output_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct2/cell_annotation.h5ad: Single-cell RNA-seq dataset annotated with malignant classification labels
